_about: External, pre-registered acceptance tests for the twelve valid_thought predicates (streams/core/valid_thought.tau, Family B). Written 2026-09-29 by the companion from the author's phrases BEFORE any generation against them; never shown to the model. The model receives only `interface` (stream names and meanings) and must produce a spec over exactly those streams. `expected` is compared exactly against the oracle's output series. Every test carries at least one step where the predicate must be F. Encodings are the companion's INFERENCE from the author's phrases; where a phrase reduces to a single bit that is stated in `note` and the learner's verdict will read `reduced` if its own `unmapped` says so.

inputs.i_wf: the candidate is a well-formed statement (decided by the parser, supplied as a bit)

statement.note: Single-bit by construction: parse-hood lives in the parser (faculty F1). An identity spec is the correct answer and is `reduced`.

inputs.i_uses_term: the thought uses a term at t
inputs.i_term_defined: that term is defined (interface or glossary)

defined_concepts.note: Holds unless a used term is undefined.

inputs.i_claim: the thought makes a claim at t
inputs.i_cites_record: that claim cites a ledger record

preserves_origin_trace.note: A claim without a record breaks the trace (TEMPLATE §2 F1–F4).

does_not_contradict_prior_reasoning.phrase: "does not contradict prior reasoning unless explicitly amended" : does_not_contradict_prior_reasoning

inputs.i_contradicts_prior: the thought contradicts accepted prior reasoning at t
inputs.i_amended: the contradiction is declared as an explicit amendment

does_not_contradict_prior_reasoning.note: The 'unless explicitly amended' clause is the whole content: contradiction is allowed only when declared.

logically_consistent_with_upstream_defin.phrase: "logical consistency with declared upstream dependencies and definitions" : logically_consistent_with_upstream_definitions

inputs.i_requires_term: the thought requires an upstream term at t
inputs.i_provider_exists: a provider for that term exists among accepted streams

logically_consistent_with_upstream_defin.note: The inventory's dangling `requires` list is exactly the F case.

inputs.i_author_declared: the thought carries a declared author at t
inputs.i_author_resolved: the declared author resolves to a known agent (model id or authenticated person)

authored_by_agent.note: Declared and resolved (TEMPLATE §2 F7, F8): an alias that resolves to nothing is not authorship.

inputs.i_author_declared: the thought carries a declared author at t
inputs.i_identity_stream_exists: an agents/seed/*.tau identity stream exists for that author

has_identity_stream.note: No author, no identity stream to have.

inputs.i_lineage_evaluated: the thought's lineage (its amendment ancestry) was evaluated at t

outputs.o_evaluates_lineage: the predicate holds at t: lineage has been evaluated at t and at every earlier step

evaluates_lineage.note: Reflexive integrity is cumulative: one skipped evaluation breaks the lineage for good (o[t] = i[t] & o[t-1], o[0] = i[0]). This is the companion's reading of 'evaluates lineage' as a standing obligation, not a per-step bit; a per-step spec fails step 4.

inputs.i_coherence_checked: a coherence check ran on the thought at t

checks_coherence.note: An unchecked thought does not 'check coherence' even if it happens to be coherent.

inputs.i_status_checked: the thought's amendment status was checked at t
inputs.i_status_current: the status found is current (no pending amendment supersedes it)

inputs.i_term_used: the thought uses a term in its body at t
inputs.i_term_declared: that term is in its interface (provides/requires) or the glossary

declares_all_terms_in_interface.note: Same shape as defined_concepts, different scope: the thought's own interface, not the network glossary.

inputs.i_term_from_outside: the thought uses a term that belongs to another instance's object (the wall)
inputs.i_term_used: the thought uses any term at t

does_not_leak_terms.note: A leak is a used term from outside the wall (TEMPLATE §2 F17); step 4 has an outside term available but unused, so no leak.
